label: Gioddu
note: Sardinian gioddu is listed in Italy's register of traditional food products; its starter, sa madrighe, is milk curdled with calf rennet

about.text: A Sardinian fermented milk, white, creamy and quite acidic (pH about 3.8–4.2), made by back-slopping from boiled or pasteurised milk. A starter called sa madrighe, milk curdled with calf rennet and left for one to two days, can start it, and it is ready in about 8 hours.
